post.summary: Create PDF export for a Prime Change Order
post.description:
Creates a PDF export for a given Prime Change Order.
Note: This endpoint is currently only supported in Procore Zones US01 && US02.

parameters.name: prime_change_order_id
parameters.description: Unique identifier for the Prime Change Order. See `GET /rest/v1.0/projects/{project_id}/prime_change_orders`.

wbs_pdf_groups.description: Optional WBS grouping for the generated PDF. Each entry is a WBS segment ID, optionally suffixed with a zero-indexed tier (e.g. `"123"` to group by the segment, or `"123,0"` to group by the segment and tier). Omit to use the default grouping.

204.description: No Content. The PDF export job was accepted and enqueued for asynchronous generation. Poll the GET endpoint to retrieve the generated document.

code.description: HTTP status in screaming snake case (like BAD_REQUEST)

reason_code.description: A machine-readable code that identifies the error specifically enough for the client to interpret what happened and take action.

x-code-samples.title: Node.js
Python3
x-code-samples.content:
import http.client

conn = http.client.HTTPSConnection("api.procore.com")

payload = "{\"wbs_pdf_groups\":[\"123\",\"456,2\"]}"

headers = { 'content-type': "application/json" }

conn.request("POST", "/rest/v2.0/companies/%7Bcompany_id%7D/projects/%7Bproject_id%7D/prime_change_orders/%7Bprime_change_order_id%7D/pdf", payload, headers)

res = conn.getresponse()
data = res.read()

print(data.decode("utf-8"))
